ota.summary: Innovo RedBox Fury Garage 2026.09.23.10 - FIXES A REGRESSION IN .05 that broke Improv-BLE provisioning on factory-fresh units. The authorizer was a template binary_sensor with a lambda; TemplateBinarySensor is setup_priority::HARDWARE (800) and its setup() calls loop() immediately, so it published ON about 500 priority levels before esp32_improv registered its state callback at AFTER_BLUETOOTH (300). Improv never saw the transition, authorized_start_ stayed 0, and because BinarySensor::send_state_internal() dedups, no later publish of the same value could fire the callback either - so Improv sat in AWAITING_AUTHORIZATION forever and refused WIFI_SETTINGS with ERROR_NOT_AUTHORIZED. The gate locked out everyone instead of only onboarded units. The authorizer now carries NO lambda (so setup() disable_loop()s and publishes nothing) and is published explicitly from on_boot at priority 200, below Improv's 300. Both outcomes are now logged at ERROR level so they are visible at the field log level: 'Improv BLE provisioning AUTHORIZED' or '... LOCKED (already onboarded; factory reset to re-open)'.
